keyEvents.text: Goal! Anaitasuna 0, Alaves 1. Jonny Otto (Alaves) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mariano Díaz.
Julen Aramendi (Anaitasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Anaitasuna 0, Alaves 2. Mariano Díaz (Alaves) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jonny Otto with a through ball.
Goal! Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 2. Carlos Juaristi (Anaitasuna) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Aimar Guembe.
First Half ends, Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 2.
Second Half begins Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 2.
Delay in match because of an injury Nicolás Valentini (Alaves).
Delay in match because of an injury Aimar Guembe (Anaitasuna).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 3. Miguel Rodríguez (Alaves) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Carles Aleñá with a cross.
Goal! Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 4. Mariano Díaz (Alaves) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ángel Pérez.
Substitution, Anaitasuna. Luis Juaristi replaces Hicham Hazim.
Substitution, Alaves. Selu Diallo replaces Carlos Protesoni.
Substitution, Alaves. Aitor Mañas replaces Ángel Pérez.
Substitution, Anaitasuna. Julen Olaizola replaces Ander Pastrian.
Substitution, Anaitasuna. Ekai Sudupe replaces Julen Larramendi.
Substitution, Alaves. Nahuel Tenaglia replaces Nicolás Valentini.
Substitution, Alaves. Ander Guevara replaces Denis Suárez.
Substitution, Alaves. Toni Martínez replaces Mariano Díaz.
Goal! Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 5. Aitor Mañas (Alaves) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ander Guevara.
Substitution, Anaitasuna. Julen Odriozola replaces Unai Pérez.
Substitution, Anaitasuna. Jakes Díaz replaces Julen Aramendi.
Goal! Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 6. Carles Aleñá (Alaves) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Toni Martínez.
Second Half ends, Anaitasuna 1, Alaves 6.
